hypothesis: At fixed spline-control storage, fitting teacher FFN outputs recovers end-to-end behavior beyond weight-space or diagonal-input fitting, while retaining an exact first FFN.
primary_comparator: Anchored K19 raw and diagonal-activation fits; output-calibrated K19 must improve on both. K15 is a declared stronger-compression secondary arm.
primary_metric: Mean next-token CE on 16 fresh frozen validation windows (2048 targets), nats/token, 128-token reset context.
minimum_useful_effect: Output-calibrated K19 CE improves by >=0.10 nats/token over BOTH K19 raw and activation fits, and finishes within 0.30 of the teacher.
success_rule: All primary thresholds, complete arms, and fidelity checks pass. Exploratory continuation only, not confirmation.
futility_rule: Abort on nonfinite loss, source/identity/merge fidelity failure, memory failure, or 1800 seconds measurement time. Preserve completed and failed outcomes; no validation-selected checkpoints or hyperparameter retries.

authorization.user_approval_reference: User: "Hey, awesome, go ahead with the next level" after prior results and the proposed exact-first-FFN activation/output fitting; earlier explicit PRs to user fork only.
authorization.approved_resources: Bounded local CPU calibration of low-rank control-bank updates; existing public inputs; no paid service, GPU, large-model pretraining, or official test.

design.mechanism_equations: For blocks1..21 and each FFN family, Q is the orthonormalized clamped uniform cubic spline basis. Raw Xhat=QQ^T X. Activation: each input column c uses D_c=diag(E[x_lc^2]) floored at 1e-4 times that layer input mean; Xhat_c=Q(Q^T D_c Q)^-1 Q^T D_c X_c. Down uses ORIGINAL teacher gate/up intermediate second moments. Output: start from activation fit, add sum_k Q_lk*(2*A_fk*B_fk), rank8 per control; minimize normalized teacher FFN output MSE on teacher FFN inputs. Fold updates into the same K matrix controls after training.
design.control_rationale: One exact original FFN plus K full matrices per family, fixed spline geometry. All fitting variants at a K have identical final dense-control scalar counts. Raw and activation have zero optimizer updates; output calibration costs extra training. K19 totals20 FFN equivalents; K15 totals16.
design.seed_selection_method: One predeclared calibration/adapter seed; exploratory, no replication or seed selection.
design.parameter_counts: Counted from checkpoint and learned adapters; only K19/K15 output arms train. Adapters fold into existing banks and do not increase final control storage.
design.matching_track: Final analytical dense-control parameter matching, not equal fitting compute, deployed memory, or latency.
design.compute_accounting: Wall/process CPU per stage/arm and epoch. ru_maxrss retained as a runtime receipt, not compact-model memory.

data.research_wide_region_reuse_audit: Prior outcomes observed before this design. Fresh validation positions are disjoint from prior 16 windows and frozen before this run, but drawn from the same previously used official validation split; not globally untouched confirmation. Reused windows reported separately.
data.teacher_and_objective: Public pinned TinyLlama teacher only; no OpenAI outputs. Teacher-normalized FFN inputs and FFN outputs from 1024 training token positions. No validation activations used for fitting.

training.microbatch: 64 cached teacher FFN token inputs for one non-anchor block
training.bptt_length: Local FFN only; no backpropagation through attention or other blocks
training.accessible_history: Teacher inputs generated at reset context <=128
training.state_carry_and_detach: No cross-window state; cached detached teacher activations
training.document_reset_policy: Nonempty lines joined by two newlines, fixed 129-token windows may cross article boundaries.

optimizer_schedule.name: AdamW
optimizer_schedule.schedule: Cosine from LR to 0.1*LR across all updates
optimizer_schedule.initialization: A=zeros, B=Normal(0,1/sqrt(input_width)), same seed reset for each K
optimizer_schedule.order: Seeded token permutation each epoch; seeded layer permutation each 64-token minibatch; each layer sees every calibration position once per epoch.

training.precision: FP64 basis and input moments; FP32 model, adapters, optimizer, merge and evaluation
training.checkpoint_selection_rule: Final epoch only; no early stopping or best-validation selection; no LR tuning

execution.source_ownership_and_concurrent_writers: New isolated run on existing user-fork branch in explicitly authorized Linux workspace; historical macOS mount restrictions do not describe this host.
execution.canary_matrix: Independent weighted least squares, full-rank identity, factored-vs-dense adapter forward/input/parameter gradients and complete AdamW step; full-size anchor hashes, teacher replay, all-layer merge and depth-subspace checks.
execution.cost_estimate: Existing checkpoint/data; 4 CPU threads; <=30 minutes; rank8 updates only, no GPU.

evaluation.primary_endpoint: 2048 fresh validation targets; reused 2048 validation targets secondary; full-vocabulary teacher KL and top1 agreement.
evaluation.duplicate_policy: Teacher reused-window CE must reproduce parent; repeat first fresh teacher window; compare premerge vs merged FFN outputs on 64 calibration inputs for every non-anchor layer.
evaluation.uncertainty_method: Paired per-window CE differences and descriptive standard errors; one training seed, 16 windows per region; no population or confirmation claim.
evaluation.multiple_comparison_policy: All seven arms retained; K19 primary and K15 secondary declared before measurement; no adaptive retuning.

deployment.memory_components: Analytical control storage only. Model weights are materialized for evaluation. Extra train-time rank8 factors fold into existing controls.

evidence.preservation_policy: Keep immutable source/protocol/metrics and exact FP32 adapter factors; deterministic original-weight projection plus saved factors reconstructs final weights. Public checkpoint/corpus remain at pinned sources with hashes; do not redistribute corpus text.

decision.next_experiment: Decide from results; no automatic follow-up launch
